subject: FOCUS DECISION: order-independent peer panel role after logical-display remap
body: WORKSTREAM_ID=ws-performance-rd-panel-role-remap-coherence-20261002. WORKSTREAM_STATE=FOCUS_SELECTED_NOT_YET_CLAIMED. STARTING_MAIN_SHA=7a612a0fe3181768f548a1ec78d2c3ee5938a339. REVISED_DISCOVERY after disproving the prior top hypothesis: C1 PANELENGINE_PEER_ROLE_REMAP_COHERENCE score=26 [IMPACT=4,EVIDENCE_DEFICIT=5,ARCHITECTURAL_LEVERAGE=4,VALIDATION_TRACTABILITY=3,SYMPTOM_RELEVANCE=4,PRIMARY_NEED=3,DUPLICATION=0,BLOCKER=1]; C2 CROSS_DIRECTION_UNTOKENED_PHYSICAL_WAKE score=22 [5,4,5,2,4,3,2,2]; C3 MIRROR_SESSION_OPEN_LIFECYCLE score=14; C4 COVER_ROUTE_REASSERT_SINGLE_FLIGHT score=13 after shell-serialization negative result; C5 NEWEST_STARTED_FRAME_ORDERING score=13 but already consumed by Gen3 Alpha1; C6 TERMINAL_NATIVE_HANDOFF score=13 but already active. SELECTED_GAP_TYPE=CONCURRENCY_GAP+LIFECYCLE_GAP+RENDERING_GAP+TEST_GAP. GAP_STATEMENT=PanelEngine refreshes its own innerPanel role inside evaluate(), but hasLiveInnerElsewhere reads other engines' cached innerPanel fields. When Samsung remaps logical IDs between physical panels and both engines are live, the first engine evaluated can classify the cover as non-concurrent until its peer is evaluated. Current result therefore depends on engines iteration order. Decisive reduced model using the exact shader formulas reproduces a severe branch difference at hinge=150deg: old-inner/new-cover engine evaluated first selects non-concurrent cover tilt 89.5 (max frost), while evaluating the new-inner peer first selects concurrent-cover tilt 0.0; a fresh-peer-geometry model is 0.0 in both orders. Gen3 Alpha1 apply scripts modify PanelEngine continuity prime plumbing but do not change this peer-role closure. INDEPENDENT_BOUNDARY=autonomous/fallback PanelEngine role coherence during logical-display remap; excludes privileged cover composition, semantic re-close, hinge coalescing, terminal handoff, and frame freshness. CHEAPEST_NEXT_ACTION=source-complete patch sketch using fresh peer geometry or two-phase role snapshot plus order-invariance tests.
